text:
sophie chen: Quick kickoff: OpenForge Labs wants their 13B open-weight in cloud marketplaces + sold as an SI HW + runtime bundle. Need clarity on redistribution, reseller rights, and what the marketplace teams will accept. @ana legal @oliver grant

raj patel: Do we have the vendor's license snippet? specifically around redistribution and relicensing?

maya lopez: Vendor sent a custom permissive grant with two called-out constraints: attribution required in product UX and a restriction that raw weights cannot be redistributed or relicensed. Uploaded their PDF to the partnership share.

ana legal: read the addendum. the "no redistribution" language is overbroad and will block marketplace listing and SI bundling. suggestion: carve out hosted endpoints and authorized channel partner distribution (packaged containers) but prohibit raw weight dumps.

ana legal: for attribution, ask for documentation/marketing-level attribution and a footer link in-th UI rather than forcing intrusive modal copy. reasonable compromise.

oliver grant: marketplace perspective: we can list models with those carveouts, but each cloud marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure) has different metadata fields. we'll need a redistribution appendix that states what artifacts we will host (inference endpoint, quantized container, NOT raw checkpoint) and a legal flag for the marketplace review.

raj patel: SI partner is insisting they must be allowed to ship a prebuilt container with runtime + quantized weights to their end customers under our reseller agreement. vendor's "no relicensing" cookieblocks that. we need a reseller/packaging exception.

ana legal: proposed reseller exception text (summary): allow Redwood and authorized resellers to distribute packaged, "non-extractable" runtime images to end customers, provided reasonable technical controls prevent exfiltration of raw weights and vendor attribution is preserved. include requirement for vulnerability/security updates and a short notice period for breaking changes.

oliver grant: technical controls note: ops prefers documented attestation + packaging guidelines (e.g., encrypted segments, key-protected KV cache) over heavy cryptography. we accept a contractual restriction plus a documented packaging spec.

maya lopez: i'll draft a plain-language vendor note explaining why we need the reseller carveout and what "non-extractable" means at a high level. vendor education piece only.

raj patel: ops/eng: can you produce a minimal checklist for the marketplace and SI? items: 1) container cannot include raw .bin weights downloadable, 2) runtime enforces key gating or obfuscation, 3) test instructions to verify non-extractability, 4) update/patch cadence, 5) attribution metadata file.

oliver grant: i'll map that checklist to cloud marketplace metadata fields and flags. expect small differences: AWS requires explicit redistribution flags, GCP wants a single-line license summary, Azure has UI attribution guidance. i'll note them.

ana legal: i'll put together a one-paragraph addendum template & a 6-point internal checklist (legal + eng + marketplace) by EOD tomorrow for review.

sophie chen: timeline: we need the draft addendum and checklist before committing to the joint announcement window. vendor wants to target a co-launch in ~3 weeks.

oliver grant: co-launch ok if legal/checklist ready and SI signs off on packaging automation. otherwise push announcement.

raj patel: i'll coordinate with the SI to confirm they can sign the reseller terms and run the packaging test harness.

maya lopez: once draft is ready i'll send it to vendor with clear bullets and offer a short sync to walk through technical requirements.

ana legal: uploading draft in ~2 hours, will include suggested contract language and fallback wording if vendor refuses (we can offer hosted-only listing with stronger attribution).

marketplace-bot: Doc uploaded: https://redwood-internal/share/openforge-13b-addendum-v1.pdf (access: partnerships+marketplace).

sophie chen: Recap actions: 1) @ana legal deliver addendum + internal checklist by EOD tomorrow 2) @raj confirm SI packaging acceptance & timeline 3) @oliver translate checklist into marketplace flags and note per-cloud differences 4) @maya send vendor comms and schedule sync after draft.

sophie chen: thanks all. we'll stand up an RFC in #partner-rfc once legal doc finalized. :v:
